editorial.blurb: KANSAKU brings fresh-caught Japanese seafood to Evanston with creative presentations and a crew that genuinely cares about your experience.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a Sunday afternoon when David and the crew are on—regulars swear by the consistent quality and attentive service, and you'll avoid the Friday night rush chaos.

topDishes.note: Fresh lobster in a tasty creative variation
